headline: New Jersey would give DEP data center study power
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

New Jersey would give DEP the power to study environmental impacts of data center development and bar construction of new data centers until that study is complete. Not passed. It cites the fear that data centers are taking the power and the water.

122 measures in 33 jurisdictions would pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them.

80 measures in 30 jurisdictions cite the fear that an algorithm decides what people pay.

2,238 measures tracked. 754 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
